title: Terrain source tile set
description: A heightfield source split over several files (CT-22, ADR-8595, docs/formats/terrain.md § 15): one global count grid, its mapping, and the schema-2 JSON or 16-bit PNG files that cover it. Neighboring tiles may share a border of at most max_overlap samples, whose counts must be equal. Unknown fields are an error. Kept in step with the serde fields by regia_terrain's test `the_tile_set_schema_names_every_descriptor_field`.

terrain_source_tiles.description: Descriptor version. Another version is refused with terrain_tiles_version before any other field is read.

cell_m.description: Sample spacing on X and Z, meters.

sample0_m.description: World X/Z of global sample (0, 0), the south-west sample center.

zero_counts.description: The count at height zero (the datum).

max_overlap.description: Widest border two tiles may share, samples. A wider shared region is refused with terrain_tiles_overlap.

tiles.description: The tiles, in any order (the reader sorts them by origin row, then column).

path.description: File relative to the descriptor's folder, '/'-separated, no '.' or '..' segment: a schema-2 JSON source (its own sample0 must sit within 1 mm of its origin's position) or a 16-bit grayscale PNG (placed by the descriptor; a datum tEXt, if any, must equal zero_counts).

origin.description: Global [column, row] of the tile's sample (0, 0).

size.description: [columns, rows] the tile file holds (terrain_tiles_dimensions when the file differs).
